text:
Dara Nguyen: quick design QA on the channel preview modal for SLO alerts. prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/example/channel-preview-compact
Jonas Becker: looks crisp. main thing: the preview modal feels heavy when you just want to check which channels are active. Can we offer a compact peek (no header chrome) vs full preview?
Priya Raman: compact peek is fine but must remain keyboard accessible. If it's non-modal, make sure it is reachable by tab order and announced with role=region + aria-live when content changes.
Dara Nguyen: good call. Also microcopy: the state currently reads "Channel: disabled". Suggest "Channel (disabled)" so it reads more naturally in list voices.
Jonas Becker: visual: when many channels are present, items wrap awkwardly. switch to a horizontal scroll with visible fade masks, and add a +N overflow button that opens full modal.
Priya Raman: accessibility: horizontal scroll needs visible focusable items and keyboard arrows should move between channels. Add aria-roledescription="carousel" and provide next/prev buttons.
A11yBot: automated-check: 1978009999 - missing-focus-outline on compact peek; contrast-pass for new tokens recommended. Report: https://ci.internal/a11y/1978009999
Dara Nguyen: action items: Jonas - prototype horizontal scroll + +N overflow behavior; Priya - keyboard/aria plan and sample markup; I'll update copy to "Channel (disabled)" and push new frames. Will follow up with ticket.
A11yBot: created ticket: design/1978009999 "channel preview: compact peek + horizontal overflow". ETA: 1978010085
